description: MCP Tool Manifest — free third-party APIs the datro flywheel uses to generate data-driven bug fixes and UX improvements per branch.

tools.name: Google PageSpeed Insights
tools.description: Lighthouse scores for performance, accessibility, SEO, best-practices. Returns 0-100 per category plus CrUX field data.
tools.confidence: high — Google production API, deterministic results

tools.name: EAA WCAG Compliance Checker
tools.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance scan. Returns overall score 0-100, per-category pass/fail (images, headings, landmarks, forms, contrast, ARIA).
tools.confidence: high — verified working, no auth needed

tools.name: AccessScore ADA/WCAG Scanner
tools.description: ADA/WCAG 2.1 legal risk scoring. Returns score, issues list with severity, fix suggestions. 16 automated checks.
tools.confidence: medium — returns data but issue list can be empty on simple pages

tools.name: SiteAudit MCP
tools.description: MCP server for AI agents. No install needed — runs in MCPize playground. Full SEO + security + performance + Lighthouse audit in one tool call.

tools.name: SEO Autopilot
tools.description: Multi-tenant SEO automation. 11 analyzers, 80+ checks. Python/FastAPI. Can be self-hosted alongside the flywheel.

tools.name: @power-seo/audit
tools.description: Zero-dependency SEO audit engine. Runs in Node.js — no API calls needed. Returns 0-100 score, per-category breakdowns, issue list with severity.
tools.confidence: medium — npm package, would need to bundle for CF Worker

tools.name: seoscan
tools.description: Full SEO audit CLI with AI-powered fix suggestions. 9 categories. Scores 0-100 with letter grade.
tools.confidence: medium — CLI tool, needs Node.js host

tools.name: CF Browser Rendering SEO Worker
tools.free_tier: within CF Workers free tier (Browser Rendering has separate pricing)
tools.description: Cloudflare Worker that uses Browser Rendering API + Workers AI (Llama 3.2) to analyze SEO. Hono + Durable Objects. Reference pattern for CF-native auditing.
tools.confidence: high — runs natively on CF Workers, proven pattern

tools.name: AI SEO Audit (context.dev)
tools.description: AEO/GEO audit — scores URL for ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity citation readiness. 30+ AI-readability checks. JSON API at /api/audit.
tools.confidence: medium — needs context.dev API key, newer project

notes: PSI requires a Google Cloud API key — set PSI_API_KEY in CF Worker env vars.
EAA + AccessScore require no auth — ideal for initial release.
cf-browser-rendering-seo is the best pattern for CF-native deep SEO analysis (real browser rendering).
For maximum coverage: PSI (perf/SEO/a11y) + EAA (WCAG) + AccessScore (ADA legal risk) in parallel on each release.
